projects.title: OffRoad-R — Adventure marketplace
projects.summary: Full marketplace (web + iOS + Android) connecting off-road equipment owners with people who want to rent adventures on demand. I led the project through MVP for the U.S. market.
projects.post:
**OffRoad-R: Adventure On Demand** is a full outdoor adventure rental marketplace — with web pages and native iOS/Android apps — connecting people who own equipment (ATVs, UTVs, kayaks, boats, and more) with people who want that kind of experience.

Built for the U.S. market, the product covers the full journey: adventure discovery, bookings, payments, partner management, and mobile UX. The marketing site is at [offroad-r.com](https://offroad-r.com/), the customer web app at [customer.offroad-r.com](https://customer.offroad-r.com/), plus apps on the [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/offroad-r/id6751864369) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.offroadr.app).

### My role

I led the project through MVP conception and delivery: product alignment, technical decisions, architecture, and fullstack execution. It was a chance to lead a U.S.-facing product, strengthen English in day-to-day work, and apply cloud techniques for scalable, lower-cost, on-demand infrastructure.

### What the product delivers

- Partner / peer marketplace to list and rent equipment and experiences
- iOS and Android apps for discovery and booking
- Web apps (marketing + customer) for conversion and operations
- Booking flows, near real-time availability, and reservation management
- Categories across land, water, air, and snow (ATV, UTV, kayak, boating, snow, and more)

### What did I learn?

Technical leadership through MVP, English communication with U.S. stakeholders, and cloud architecture (serverless / on-demand) to scale without high fixed cost. Strengthened the full cycle: mobile, web, backend, and AWS.

### Technologies used:

React Native • React • NestJS • AWS Cloud • AWS Lambda • Amazon Cognito • APIs • Git

### How to explore?

- Website: [https://offroad-r.com/](https://offroad-r.com/)
- Customer web: [https://customer.offroad-r.com/](https://customer.offroad-r.com/)
- iOS: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/offroad-r/id6751864369)
- Android: [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.offroadr.app)

Private repository (source code is not public).

projects.title: PDF Studio — Online PDF editor
projects.summary: A free, fast, private in-browser PDF editor, compressor and signer. Born from frustration with tools that charge for basics; Next.js frontend only, monetized with Google Ads.
projects.post:
**PDF Studio** is a complete toolkit to manipulate PDFs for free — simple and fast: edit text, sign, merge, split, compress, annotate, insert images and export — all in the browser, with nothing to install.

Live at [pdf.brunoholanda.com](https://pdf.brunoholanda.com/). Processing happens on the user’s device (frontend only), so files don’t need to leave the computer for editing — better privacy for contracts and sensitive docs.

### Why it exists

The project started from my frustration with sites that charge for basic PDF tasks. I come from a time when you could do almost everything online for free — and I wanted to bring that freedom back: a useful, accessible editor without friction.

### What the product delivers

- Edit native PDF text (formatting, multiline, repositioning)
- Sign online (draw or type)
- Merge, split, compress and organize pages
- Annotations, highlights, shapes, images, header/footer
- Editor UX with shortcuts, zoom, undo/redo and download

### Architecture and monetization

Built with **Next.js** as a **frontend-only** app. Monetization uses **Google Ads**, keeping the core experience free instead of locking essentials behind a paywall.

### What did I learn?

Shipping a SaaS-like product focused on client-side UX and performance, SEO for search intents (edit/compress/sign PDF), and a sustainable model that doesn’t charge users for the essential feature.

### Technologies used:

Next.js • React • JavaScript • Frontend • Google AdSense / Ads • Git

### How to use?

Go to [https://pdf.brunoholanda.com/](https://pdf.brunoholanda.com/), open the editor, pick a PDF and edit, sign, merge or compress. Then download — everything runs locally in the browser.

Private repository (source code is not public).

projects.summary: A system to create marketing campaigns with videos and images and generate a link to play on a display panel. Built for EV charger owners who monetize ads on charger screens.
projects.post:
**Kiosk (Quiosque)** is a campaign system for digital panels: users build campaigns with videos and images, then get a link to open on the display that plays the content.

Live at [quiosque.brunoholanda.com](https://quiosque.brunoholanda.com/login). It was created for EV charger owners — stations with screens that show (and charge for) ads while people charge.

### How it works

- Create and manage campaigns (new, edit, delete)
- Add media: images and videos per campaign
- Copy the campaign link and open it on the charger kiosk/panel
- Preview and organize what will appear on screen

### Problem it solves

EV station operators need to update on-screen ads without a painful manual process. With Quiosque, campaigns live in the admin panel and the display only needs the generated link.

### What did I learn?

Designing a simple CMS + player flow: media management in the backoffice and reliable playback on the panel, aimed at real monetization of screens on EV chargers.

### Technologies used:

React • JavaScript • Frontend • Panel UX • Git

### How to explore?

Visit [https://quiosque.brunoholanda.com/login](https://quiosque.brunoholanda.com/login), create campaigns with videos/images and use the generated link on the display panel.

projects.title: AluraGeek
projects.summary: Alura Geek is a fictional marketplace that brings together Geek products for purchase. In this project, it was possible to practice React's UseStates...
projects.post:
Alura Geek is a fictional marketplace developed to bring together products related to the Geek universe for online purchases. This type of platform is very interesting for fans of pop culture and technology, as it offers a wide variety of products. 

 To make the platform more attractive and functional, React, a very popular JavaScript library for user interface development, was used. With React, it was possible to implement several interesting features in Alura Geek, such as using UseStates. 

 UseStates are a React feature that allows the creation of state variables that can be modified over time. They are very useful for implementing dynamic functionalities on a website, such as updating information in real-time or changing colors and images when hovering over a product. 

 Finally, it is important to highlight that using React in the Alura Geek project enabled more agile and efficient development, as the library simplifies many of the complex tasks involved in creating an e-commerce platform. This allowed the project developers to focus more on creating an attractive design and an intuitive user interface, ensuring a pleasant shopping experience for users. 

 ### What did I learn? 

 My biggest learning in this project was the practice of JavaScript in React. Creating this feature to add new products, even though it was not the first time I developed this type of feature, was not easy, but I understood that it is something that can be implemented in various applications. 

 ### Technologies used: 

 ReactJS • JavaScript • HTML • SASS • Git

projects.title: E-Commerce
projects.summary: This project is a dropshipping e-commerce developed with Shopify and integrated with various applications to optimize product...
projects.post:
Welcome to our brand new Dropshipping E-Commerce! 🌐🛍️

We have developed an intuitive and efficient platform for you to explore and purchase high-quality products with just a few clicks. Using the powerful Shopify platform, our site is packed with features that make online shopping simple and enjoyable.

## What is Dropshipping?

Dropshipping is a business model where the store does not keep products in stock. Instead, when a customer places an order, the item is purchased from a third-party supplier and shipped directly to the customer. This allows offering a wide range of products without the need to manage inventory.

## Why Choose Our E-Commerce?

- **Ease of Use:** Navigate our site intuitively and easily find the products you want.
- **Security:** Secure payment processes to protect your information.
- **Variety:** A wide selection of high-quality products.
- **Support:** Dedicated customer service to assist you at every step of your purchase.

## Technologies Used

- **Shopify:** Robust and reliable platform for creating online stores.
- **Integrated Applications:** Tools to optimize product, order, and marketing management.
- **Responsive Design:** Optimized browsing experience for all devices.

## How It Works?

1. **Browse the Site:** Explore our wide range of products.
2. **Add to Cart:** Select the desired items and add them to your cart.
3. **Checkout:** Complete your purchase quickly and securely.
4. **Receive at Home:** Wait for your order to arrive comfortably at your home.

👉 Visit our e-commerce now: [NerdKing Store](https://nerdkingloja.com.br)

Want to know more about our platform and how we created this project? Check out our repository on Shopify: [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com/br)
